description:
Sandbox only: run a subscription's next renewal right now, succeeding or failing, to test subscription.renewed / subscription.payment_failed / subscription.canceled handling without waiting a billing period. No money moves.

Refused with a live (jamidev_live_) token — live renewals only run on schedule.

Args:
  - subscription_id: the sub_… id of a sandbox subscription.
  - outcome: 'success' (default) or 'failure'. Failures follow the real dunning schedule: retries at 1, 3 and 7 days, then the subscription is canceled with cancellation_reason payment_failed.

Returns: { result: 'renewed' | 'retry_scheduled' | 'canceled' | 'skipped' | 'deferred', subscription }.

response_format.description: 'markdown' (default) for a readable summary, 'json' for the full structured payload

subscription_id.description: Subscription id, e.g. "sub_9f2kQ…" from jami_list_subscriptions or a subscription.* webhook

name: jami_simulate_subscription_renewal

amount_minor.description: Charged every period, integer santim (locked at approval)

next_charge_at.description: Next renewal or retry; null once canceled or set to end

title: Simulate subscription renewal
